content: Disifin is a commercially available disinfectant that comes in tablet or powder form. It is widely utilized across various settings, including hospitals, laboratories, nursing homes, funeral homes, and medical, dental, and veterinary facilities. It is also employed in any environment where pathogen control is essential. The solution is primarily used for disinfecting surfaces and soaking medical or laboratory equipment. Disifin exhibits an extensive antimicrobial spectrum, demonstrating efficacy against viruses, bacteria, fungi, yeasts, and spores. It is also effective against mycobacteria, including Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Furthermore, it has proven effectiveness against pathogens responsible for Foot-and-Mouth Disease and Avian Influenza. For optimal disinfection, the solution must be generously applied to the surface and left undisturbed for a minimum of 15 minutes before being wiped off.
